decision: Adopt this single structural hypothesis as the prospective next design, conditional on source-label qualification and independent full-experiment review. No alternative head/weight/target choice is reserved for selection from S/Z values.

fixed_structural_choices.extra_head: One9-parameter Linear(8,1), same B/C architecture and zero initialization with original RNG restored
fixed_structural_choices.target_scaling: Each target float64 mean/std(ddof=1) over the same original3014 matured rows, then one float32 cast; no clipping or epsilon fallback
fixed_structural_choices.additional_loss: 0.02 * 0.5 * mean squared error on standardized target
fixed_structural_choices.original_training: Keep original objectives, auxiliary domain, one globalclip2 and AdamW/seed/epoch budget; no PG, detach or domain-head intervention
fixed_structural_choices.gradient_caveat: Global clipping couples new-head gradients to other parameter updates; only a complete matched B/C package may be attributed.

evidence_boundary: Proposal was registered before any actual price/label phase. A/B source qualification now completed; fixed S/Z have not been constructed. No target means, variances, prediction scores or economic results were used to select these choices. Weight is an ex-ante design choice, not a paper recommendation.
still_required: Source C qualification; full immutable dataset/model/reference/cost/gate bindings and independent model-design review before implementation or any fit. This owner selection does not certify model eligibility or success.
